pattern: ^SELECT (.*), COUNT\(*\) as (.*?) FROM (.*?) GROUP BY (.*?) ORDER BY (.*?) DESC LIMIT 1 \) as (.*?) ON (.*)\.(.*?) = (.*?)\.(\*|ID)$
correction: Join the tables directly and use aggregate functions within the SELECT statement instead of using a subquery.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that incorrectly use subqueries when joining tables, and suggests to join the tables directly instead.
